rich2021Activities: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L15 is a learner-designed ESTIMATION EXPLORATION, not a fixed arithmetic worksheet. Student chooses an image where multi-digit multiplication helps estimate count, then runs a peer conversation about low, reasonable and high guesses.

Warm-up Estimation Exploration Umbrellas has a credited Joseph Chan CC0 Unsplash image, asks how many umbrellas are pictured and solicits too-low/about-right/too-high estimates. The exact visible count is NOT in text, so do not invent a certified original correct count.

Activity1 Design Your Estimation Exploration requires learner to find an image showing many countable objects with some structure, create candidate estimates too low/about right/too high, and explain an approximate rows×columns or groups reasoning.

Activity2 Facilitate Your Estimation Exploration: student displays own picture, asks classmates separately for too high, too low and about right estimates, provides a minute of quiet reflection and peer discussion, and records actual explanations.

Student-selected figures and audience estimates have no globally fixed correct value. Exact selected digital cases cover original instructions only, while image source, estimation reasonableness and mathematical discussion are TEACHER_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
